verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs describe general agentic capabilities—reproducing issues and verifying fixes, inspecting diffs before merge, and autonomous agents that build/test/fix code—which plausibly cover writing tests and fixing bugs, but none of the evidence explicitly confirms lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, or dependency updates as specific supported workflows. Community evidence focuses on product reliability complaints rather than these specific capabilities, leaving the claim only partially substantiated.
